swimming_adults.title: Swimming Adults
swimming_adults.desc: Improve technique and fitness in a structured environment.

swimming_juniors.title: Swimming Juniors
swimming_juniors.desc: Aquatic skill development for young athletes.
swimming_juniors.long_desc: We foster a love for water while teaching correct technique, discipline, and teamwork for the next generation of swimmers.

open_water.title: Open Water
open_water.desc: Master the ocean with safety and confidence.
open_water.long_desc: Specific ocean training: sighting, entries, exits, and current management so you can swim safely in any condition.

running.title: Running
running.desc: Reach your goals on road or trail.
running.long_desc: Personalized plans for runners from 5k to ultramarathon, with emphasis on running form and injury prevention.

triathlon.title: Triathlon
triathlon.desc: Integrate swim, bike, and run into one performance.
triathlon.long_desc: Comprehensive preparation for triathletes of all distances. We optimize your training to perform at your best across all three disciplines.

about.title: Head Coach
about.name: Edgar Bonilla

bio.paragraph1: My journey started in the water, but coaching became my obsession because of one question:
bio.paragraph1_cont: do some athletes improve while others stall?
bio.paragraph2: At Atlan, we don't rely on "magic formulas." We rely on
bio.paragraph2_cont: , clear biomechanics, and habits you can actually sustain.
bio.paragraph3: My goal is to help you unlock your potential —as an athlete and as a person— with a plan built around your real life.

about.quote: Train smart. Move with purpose. Progress follows.

testimonials.title: Athlete Stories
testimonials.subtitle: Real results from athletes who train with Liquid Precision.

amanda.name: Amanda B.
amanda.content: Coach is a committed professional—passionate about what he does and highly knowledgeable. I recommend him 100% to anyone looking to improve their athletic performance seriously and effectively.

joaquin.name: Joaquín R.
joaquin.content: I had learned to swim after retiring. Thanks to the guidance and dedication and very committed. Today I swim with calm, technique, and I enjoy it to the maximum.

steisy.name: Steisy C.
steisy.content: My experience has been more than rewarding, it is a place to feel safe and relieve, the way in which Coach performs his work is very professional and transmits his love for the sport.

agustin.name: Agustin F.
agustin.content: I've trained with him in 2 moments. First as teenage swimmer and now as an adult triathlete, where we have achieved participation and podiums, sprint, olympic, 70.3 distance.

rodrigo.name: Rodrigo R.
rodrigo.content: My dream was to be able to do a triathlon. I started my process with the Coach and not only managed to do my first triathlon but I turned professional training into part of my lifestyle, including 5 Ironman 70.3.
